'''Endaw N'gard'm''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who worked for ''[[The Coruscant Holo Net]]'' newspaper during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], this reporter wrote an article about the devastating [[Battle of Phorose|battle]] of [[Phorose]].<ref name="Ru-ful War" />
